import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d import Axes3D

# Create the array t from 0 to 4*pi + 0.1
t = np.linspace(0, 4 * np.pi + 0.1, 1000)

# Define the parametric curve
x = np.cos(2 * t)
y = np.sin(2 * t)
z = np.cos(4 * t)

# Create figure and 3D axis
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection='3d')

# Create error bars
# Frequency of 20: index % 20 == 0
# AND (index // 20 % 3 == 0 OR index // 20 % 3 == 2)
n = len(t)
error_mask = (np.arange(n) % 20 == 0) & ((np.arange(n) // 20 % 3 == 0) | (np.arange(n) // 20 % 3 == 2))

# Error should be 0.3
error = 0.3

# Plot the curve
ax.plot(x, y, z, 'b-', linewidth=1.5, label='Parametric Curve')

# Plot error bars

    ax.errorbar(x[error_mask], y[error_mask], z[error_mask], 
                xerr=error, yerr=error, zerr=error,

ax.set_ylabel('Y label')
